name: product-loop
description: Unified two-tier iteration engine: Reviewer -> Scout -> Planner -> Generator -> Evaluator. Tier 1 (Reviewer, --tier1 toggle) auto-critiques the product to generate requirements; turn it off and a human-written SPRINT is the source (multi-ralph behavior). Tier 2 always runs, with Scout grounding the code before planning. Termination follows --tier1: goal-driven when off, full-iterations when on.
